name: orders
doc: An order from a restaurant that keeps its own ordering system (Toast, say). Pave holds only the order's binding: the hash of the order as the restaurant's system has it, the totals, where it goes and who confirms it, and the co-op that delivers. The customer pays the restaurant's invoice committing to the binding; the restaurant ships a parcel about it (the parcels profile), pays the co-op its fee once it's delivered, and the co-op pays its couriers. For food, the delivery itself is profiles/food.json, by badged couriers only. Menus, kitchen tickets and the order's contents stay with the restaurant.

fields.name: order
fields.doc: The hash of the order as the restaurant's system has it; the contents stay there

fields.name: total
fields.doc: What the customer pays, delivery included

fields.name: delivery
fields.doc: The part of the total the restaurant pays the co-op

fields.name: to_cell
fields.doc: A coarse location cell; the address goes only to the courier carrying it

fields.name: address
fields.doc: The salted hash of the street address: only the badged courier is given the address and salt

fields.name: deliver_to
fields.doc: The customer's key, which confirms delivery

fields.name: due
fields.doc: When it must arrive, in seconds since 1970; a delivered note stamped later by the board's clock is late
